summary: Tested the auto follow-ups and the Abhinav signature fix. Backend: 14 pytest tests (3 against the live API, 11 core unit tests run on a throwaway Mongo DB with db monkeypatched; no email was sent and no preview outreach rows were touched). 12 passed, 2 failed, and both failures are real bugs. Frontend: Outreach -> Email templates tab checked with Playwright. Signature card shows Abhinav's signature, the 8 follow-up step badges are correct, and the editor's step select and days input work. Everything requested works except the 2 bugs below.

critical.issue: After a follow-up template is edited (its updated_at changes), queued follow-up emails are re-merged from the raw template subject. {{intro_subject}} is not a merge() key, so the subject becomes the literal 'Re: {{intro_subject}}' and goes out that way. Reproduced in test_refresh_after_template_edit_keeps_intro_subject. Fix: in _refresh_from_template, replace {{intro_subject}} with m['intro_subject'] (already stored on the row) before calling tailor, the same way run_followups does.

Starvation. Each follow-up template scans only limit+50 intros (no sort). Intros it skips without marking fu_stepN stay in that window on every run: replied or bounced prospects, other audiences, and for step 3 intros whose step 2 is queued but not yet sent (likely with the 200/day cap). Once there are about 80 of them, eligible intros are never reached. Reproduced: 120 replied intros plus 1 eligible intro, run_followups(10) -> 0 follow-ups created. Fix: push the conditions into the Mongo query (join or pre-filter prospect ids by audience and not replied) and sort by sent_at, or mark permanently ineligible intros (fu_stepN='skip'), or page through all candidates.

minor.issue: Follow-ups are sent as new messages with a 'Re:' subject. There are no In-Reply-To/References headers, so they will not thread under the intro in the recipient's mail client.
The reply check only looks at prospect.replied and the intro's replied_at. inbox_sync does set prospect.replied on any reply, so this works today, but it depends on inbox_sync.

issues: The Auto emailer bar lists the 8 follow-ups under the caption 'goes out on its own to every brand with an email'. This is misleading for follow-ups, and the bar rows have no step or day badge.
The placeholder hint under the editor does not mention {{intro_subject}}, which the follow-ups use.

On follow-up cards the badges (AUTO EMAILER, Follow-up 1 · day 3, audience, sent as written) wrap into cramped two-line pills next to the long names at the 3-column xl width. Consider moving the badges to their own row.

action_items: Fix _refresh_from_template so follow-ups keep 'Re: <intro subject>' after a template edit (use m['intro_subject'])
Fix run_followups starvation: filter by audience and not-replied in the query, or mark skipped intros, or iterate all candidates sorted by sent_at
Optional: add In-Reply-To headers so follow-ups thread; label follow-ups in the Auto emailer bar; mention {{intro_subject}} in the placeholder hint
critical_code_review_comments: run_followups fetches limit-made+50 rows unsorted and filters in Python, so skipped rows are never marked and can starve eligible intros
The intro_ids query is duplicated 3 times (run_followups, run_auto, the use_template route) with slightly different filters ($nin [None,'all'] vs $in AUDIENCES). Extract it into one helper.
senders(): primary uses st.signature and extra inboxes fall back to st.signature, as the spec requires (verified)
seed_data_creation: None in the preview DB. One TEST_fu19 template was created through the API and deleted. Unit tests used throwaway DBs test_database_t19_* that are dropped afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_followups_iter19.py -n 0. The 2 failing tests (starvation and refresh subject) should pass after the fixes. Live follow-up template ids are 72-79 and intro ids 65-68. The main signature in the preview is already Abhinav's. No inbox is connected in the preview.
